title: Inbox One
description: An exploration of a brand new homepage view for the VS Code agents window. It implements an email style inbox view for agent sessions list and a chat composer. V1 — three panes: a title-bar New button (⌘N), a mailbox rail (V2's buckets: Ready for you, Working, Ready to merge, On hold, Done), a session list (search, Filter Sessions menu, two-line rows with hover actions) and a reading pane that shows the composer when nothing is selected, or the selected session's full chat (design-system chat parts, question above the composer). Keys: j/k, e done, h hold, m merge, u unread, Delete (Done), ⌘N or c new session, /, 1-5 mailboxes, Esc back. Phones show one pane at a time with the rail as a drawer.
